text: `click.prompt` catches `KeyboardInterrupt` and `EOFError` (Ctrl+C / EOF) and raises `click.exceptions.Abort` (i.e. `click.Abort`). See src/click/termui.py, in the inner `prompt_func` (lines ~144-150: `except (KeyboardInterrupt, EOFError): ... raise Abort()`); the same is done for `confirm` (line ~236). This is also what the docstring documents: "If the user aborts the input by sending a interrupt signal, this function will catch it and raise a `Abort` exception."

`fs_enc = "ascii"`. In `_verify_python_env` (src/click/_unicodefun.py lines 8-13), the `locale.getpreferredencoding()` lookup (and the `codecs.lookup(...)` normalization) is wrapped in `try/except Exception`, and the except branch sets `fs_enc = "ascii"`. If `fs_enc` ends up `"ascii"`, the function then goes on to emit the "Click will abort further execution because Python was configured to use ASCII as encoding" message (and on POSIX may `Abort`).

`RuntimeError`. If `fs_enc == "ascii"`, `_verify_python_env` builds a list of `extra` mitigation messages and ends with `raise RuntimeError("\n\n".join(extra))` (src/click/_unicodefun.py, last line). On POSIX it first tries to gather locale info via `locale -a`; if no suitable UTF-8 locales are found it appends an "Additional information" message, otherwise it suggests C.UTF-8 or lists suitable locales. (Note: in this version the RuntimeError is raised unconditionally when `fs_enc` is ascii — there is no `sys.platform`-guarded early return.)

It returns the sentinel `_flag_needs_value` (the module-level sentinel object in src/click/parser.py). In `OptionParser._get_value_from_state`, when `len(state.rargs) < nargs` and `option.obj._flag_needs_value` is true, the code sets `value = _flag_needs_value` instead of raising `BadOptionUsage` ("Option {name!r} requires an argument."). `TypeError` — `style` wraps the `_interpret_color(fg)` lookup in `try/except KeyError` and re-raises `TypeError(f"Unknown color {fg!r}")` (src/click/termui.py lines 580-584; the same is done for `bg` at lines 586-590, with `_interpret_color(bg, 10)`). `_interpret_color` does `_ansi_colors[color]` for string names, so an unknown name raises `KeyError`, which `style` converts to `TypeError`.

It returns `"Invalid value: {message}"` (i.e. `_("Invalid value: {message}").format(message=self.message)`) — src/click/exceptions.py line 120. The `else` branch is taken when both `param_hint` is None and `param` is None; otherwise it uses the hint (or `param.get_error_hint(ctx)`) and returns `"Invalid value for {param_hint}: {message}"`.

Fixed. `src/click/decorators.py`: `argument()` did `ArgumentClass = attrs.pop("cls", Argument)` inside the returned decorator, mutating the closure's `attrs` dict — so the first application consumed `cls` and every later use of the same decorator silently fell back to the base `Argument` class. Now `cls` is an explicit keyword parameter (`def argument(*param_decls, cls=None, **attrs)`) and the decorator does `ArgumentClass = cls or Argument`, leaving `attrs` untouched (matching how `option()` already copies its attrs). Verified: a decorator created once with `cls=CustomArgument` and applied to two commands now yields `CustomArgument` params both times (fails before the change, passes after), and the full suite is still 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed.

Fixed. When `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` are `None` (e.g. pythonw), `click.echo` raised `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'write'`. Fix touches the three files: `_compat.py` — `_make_cached_stream_func` now returns `None` when the source stream is `None` (so `_default_text_stdout`/`_default_text_stderr`/`_default_text_stdin` propagate `None` instead of trying to cache it); `utils.py` — `echo` returns early if the resolved file is `None`; `_termui_impl.py` — `ProgressBar` falls back to `io.StringIO()` and `pager` likewise when there is no stdout. Verified: `click.echo`, `secho`, `echo(err=True)`, byte messages, `progressbar` and `echo_via_pager` are all no-ops without raising when both streams are `None`, normal output is unaffected, and the full suite is 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed.
